Introduction. Sulfur arches are Grausten structure found in the Ashlands with Sulfur Rocks hanging below.
Sulfur rocks can be picked without tools and yield 2 to 3 Sulfurs. The Grausten arch can be mined with any pickaxe.

Availability. Sulfur arches appear as medium-sized, arch-shaped rocks with distinct black color and orange dots, which help differentiate them from regular Ashlands rocks at a distance.
They are only found on the surface.

Drops. A Sulfur arch can have up to 20 Sulfur rocks with a 40% chance for each Sulfur rock to appear (8 rock per arch on average).
